name: White Rabbit
source:
A white rabbit who lost his watch. He went to pick Alice up, but gave in to sleepiness on the way and abandoned his role as a guide. He's hard to understand. When he opens he's mouth he only says sarcasm, but he's still surprisingly kind. He hates the Chesya Neko.

[Translated from [url=http://chuclo.web.fc2.com/products/alice/index.html#chara]official website[/url]]
